entries.what: Jun opens at Heron & Grind at 6:15 with Linh, pulling shots for the Monday rush and serving Wes his 7 a.m. cortado.
entries.outcome: Rush handled; Linh picked up a tulip pour.

entries.what: On his break he photographs a tray of lumpia and drafts a caption crediting his mother's recipe, then wonders if 'Lola-approved, Mom-tested' sounds cheesy.
entries.outcome: Kept the caption to run by Tess.

entries.what: Jun heads home to Tess's house off Vinca Avenue and tells her about the caption while she checks her fridge list of coworker orders.
entries.outcome: Tess shrugged and said it was fine, which he took as approval.

entries.what: Evening of rolling wrappers at the kitchen table with old OPM ballads playing, planning the week's batches.
entries.outcome: About 80 lumpia rolled before bed.

entries.what: Early shift at the cafe; he stops at the community center after work to vote in the local election and Measure K.
entries.outcome: Voted and got his sticker.

entries.what: Jun restocks the oat milk and wipes down the bar before leaving the cafe, then buys wrappers by the case at Ruiz Family Market.
entries.outcome: Two cases bought, savings dented a bit.

entries.what: Evening call with Paolo about market setup tasks and upcoming Instagram posts.
entries.outcome: Paolo agreed to handle the posts and setup.

entries.what: Tess is off Wednesday, so Jun has her taste a test batch before his shift; she gives notes on the dipping vinegar.
entries.outcome: Vinegar recipe tweaked slightly.

entries.what: Works the cafe bar, pours a swan for a regular and trains Linh on milk texture during a lull.
entries.outcome: Linh's microfoam improved.

entries.what: Jun and Tess decide he will take frozen lumpia preorders for Thanksgiving pickup on Nov 26, and he sketches a preorder list.
entries.outcome: Preorders plan set for Nov 26 pickup.

entries.what: Opening shift at Heron & Grind; Beatrice's corgi Ledger naps in the back office.
entries.outcome: Smooth morning.

entries.what: On break Jun asks the assistant how to offer Linh paid help on market Sundays without making it weird at work, since she built his spreadsheet.
entries.outcome: Decided to ask her privately after shift.

entries.what: After work he asks Linh outside the cafe; she says she will think about it and teases him about his color-coding.
entries.outcome: Linh said she would think about it.

entries.what: Jun works the morning shift, then buys fryer-area scrub supplies for tonight's commissary block.
entries.outcome: Supplies ready.

entries.what: Standing Friday 5-9 p.m. block at the Ruel Road commissary, fryer scrubbed before Joan's inspection; Paolo is on his closing shift.
entries.outcome: No $40 fee and a full batch fried.

entries.what: Fills up at the Ruel Road station on the way home and eats al pastor at Taquería Colima.
entries.outcome: Fed and in bed by 10:30.

entries.what: Saturday at the Heron & Grind counter, selling lumpia from the Saturday table with Wes buying his two in quarters.
entries.outcome: Sold out of the 150 batch by noon.

entries.what: Afternoon spent logging sales and receipts into Linh's sheet and checking market-day supply needs.
entries.outcome: Numbers up to date.

entries.what: Evening at the canopy-and-supplies check with Paolo, loading the chest cooler for tomorrow.
entries.outcome: Everything packed for Sunday.

entries.what: Jun sets up his row C stall near the bandstand at the Delgado Park farmers market at dawn, past Rick's 7 a.m. lot walk.
entries.outcome: Stall up on time.

entries.what: Busy market morning selling lumpia; he notices Lourdes at the hot sauce booth and trades a lumpia for a bottle.
entries.outcome: Good sales and a flustered moment.

entries.what: Afternoon teardown and cash count with Paolo.
entries.outcome: Sold most of the stock.

entries.what: Evening dinner at Tess's with leftovers and talk about Thanksgiving preorders.
entries.outcome: Three coworker orders added to the fridge list.

new_facts.value: agreed to think about working Sunday market shifts for Jun

new_facts.value: traded a lumpia for a bottle of habanero hot sauce at the market

new_facts.subject: jun
new_facts.value: added more garlic to the spiced vinegar dip after Tess's notes

new_facts.value: voted in the Nov 4 local election at the community center
